          Plan your travel itinerary and flight to New York 

          Planning your trip to this vibrant city is a breeze with Saudia Airlines. You'll find it easy to book your flight to New York (JFK), with a variety of flight times to fit your schedule. Our world-class service will make your journey comfortable and memorable.

          Book your flight to New York today!

          Flight arrivals at John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK)

          When you land at John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) in New York, you’ll be greeted by a welcoming and well-organized terminal that ensures a smooth arrival experience. John F. Kennedy International Airport offers a wide range of passenger services to make your arrival in New York pleasant and convenient. Whether you’re continuing your travels or exploring New York for the first time, John F. Kennedy International Airport provides everything you need to start your visit comfortably.

           

          Discover the Empire State: Experience the Kinetic Energy of New York City

          Feel the unstoppable pulse of the world's most vibrant metropolis. New York City invites you to unlock unforgettable adventures around every corner, blending soaring architectural wonders with beautiful natural escapes. From the bright lights of midtown to historic pathways, this legendary destination inspires dreamers and travelers alike. Step into the electric atmosphere and let the city elevate your journey.


          1. Explore Central Park

          Recharge in Manhattan's premier urban oasis, rent a scenic rowboat, or enjoy a relaxing picnic on the Great Lawn. This vast green space offers a peaceful sanctuary amidst the bustling cityscape, allowing you to connect with nature while remaining in the heart of the action.


          2. Visit The Statue Of Liberty

          Sail toward this global symbol of freedom and capture stunning harbor views up close. Feel the inspiration as you approach one of the most famous monuments in the world, representing hope and new beginnings for millions of travelers throughout history.


          3. Scale Summit One Vanderbilt

          Experience an immersive, multi-sensory observation deck that blends cutting-edge art and sky-high thrills. Walk through reflective spaces that challenge your perceptions and offer breathtaking, panoramic views of the entire Manhattan skyline.


          4. Walk Across The Brooklyn Bridge

          Stroll along iconic pathways to enjoy unmatched panoramic vistas of the dazzling city skyline. This historic structure connects bustling boroughs and provides the perfect backdrop for memorable photographs and inspiring walks at sunset.


          5. Experience The 9/11 Memorial and Museum

          Discover moving exhibits and honor the inspiring resilience of humanity at the twin reflecting pools. This quiet space provides a profound look into the strength and unity of the city, leaving every visitor with a deep sense of hope.
